test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-4) Official paper (Held On: 10 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Ravish has read (4)/(5) of a book while Soma has read only (5)/(8) of the book she is reading. Both however have another 120 pages of their respective books remaining to be read. What fraction of the number of pages read by Ravish has been read by Soma?
solution:
**Given:**

Ravish has read (4)/(5) of a book

Soma has read only (5)/(8) of the book

Both however have another 120 pages of their respective books remaining to be read

**Calculation:**

Ravish has read (4)/(5) of a book

The remaining read of Ravish = (1 – 4/5) = 1/5

Soma has read only (5)/(8) of the book

The remaining read of Soma = (1 – 5/8) = 3/8

Now,

Total pages in Ravish book 

⇒ 1/5 = 120 pages

⇒ 600 pages

Total pages in Soma book

⇒ 3/8 = 120

⇒ 320 pages

Now,

The fraction of the number of pages read by Ravish has been read by Soma is

⇒ (320 × 5/8)/(600 × 4/5)

⇒ 200/480

⇒ 5/12

**∴ The fraction of the number of pages read by Ravish has been read by Soma is (5)/(12)**
